brief:
The UK Home Office warned Hackney Council officials that a Tribune magazine event featuring a pro-Palestine activist could breach counter-terror laws, according to disclosures reported by Middle East Eye. The warning prompted consideration of canceling the gathering, though the full details of the Home Office's pressure remain unclear from available records.

The episode raises questions about state intervention in public events and free speech protections for political activism in Britain. Counter-terror legislation has increasingly been cited in efforts to restrict Palestinian solidarity organizing and speech in the UK.

title: Home Office pressures council to cancel pro-Palestine activist event
